environment_issue: Docker initially activating; no restart. Trial processes use IPv4 preference. S3 listing is denied; random namespace and conditional PUT prevent overwrite.
scope: Dedicated WordPress only; no production changes. Standard core block subset, administrators only.

s3.retention_checks: GOVERNANCE, >=35 days from stored time and unexpired; SHA256 and exact Version ID verified

namespace_check.collision_guard: random 64-bit scope plus If-None-Match: * on every PUT; no overwrite

product_fix.issue: Native media-modal synchronous 12-second wait reported an error while live S3 storage continued. First run failed; its evidence was retained.
product_fix.change: Queue acceptance returns immediately; media uploader polls the existing state API, checks operation identity, applies only stored material and resumes its queue after a real attachment exists.

test_infrastructure.change: Media completion assertion waits up to 220 seconds and requires native uploader queue to drain, instead of a 40-second snapshot-only timeout. No manual completion assistance.
test_infrastructure.failure_injection: Worker fail_before prevents PUT; stop_after_store interrupts after committed generation. These are deterministic injected failures, not induced AWS outages.
